ci_observed.name: Validate Surah 108 I05 authorial and reported voices and R01

evidence_target_review.finding: Existing evidence supports Ibn Kathir's compiler reporting statement. Attaching an al-Hakim/Israil transmission route to this evidence would misleadingly route the compiler commentary through reported transmitters.
evidence_target_review.decision: Do not add a route row targeting 108-I05-R02-E.
evidence_target_review.required_next: Design a distinct reported-citation evidence unit for the abbreviated al-Hakim citation, with an explicit staging dependency to R01. Keep it separate from evidence for compiler commentary; do not duplicate a dialogue proposition or claim independent corroboration.
